stem.text: The diagram shows two parallel metal plates connected to a d.c. power supply through a resistor.

stem.alt: Two parallel metal plates connected by wires through a resistor to terminals labelled + and −.

stem.text: There is a uniform electric field in the region between the plates.
Which change would cause a **decrease** in the strength of the electric field?

A.text: a small increase in the distance between the plates

B.text: a small increase in the potential difference between the plates

C.text: a small increase in the resistance of the resistor

D.text: a small increase to the area of both plates
